data.title: Skyfame Realty Narrows Interim Loss but Trading Suspension Persists Amid Liquidation
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Skyfame Realty (Holdings) Ltd ( (HK:0059) ).

Skyfame Realty, a Bermuda-incorporated Chinese property developer listed in Hong Kong and currently in liquidation, remains under trading suspension amid ongoing efforts to address its financial and regulatory challenges. The group’s core activities in property sales and related services are constrained by high leverage and restructuring uncertainties, leaving investors exposed to continued balance-sheet and operational risk.

In its unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2025, the company reported revenue of RMB51.7 million and a narrowed loss of RMB174.2 million, helped by a substantial reversal of impairment on amounts due from deconsolidated subsidiaries. However, net finance costs of RMB266 million continue to dominate the income statement, and the winding-up status plus unresolved resumption guidance from the exchange suggest that trading in the shares and bonds will remain suspended, with limited visibility for stakeholders on recovery prospects.

data.title: Strong Petrochemical Wins Trading Resumption After Governance Overhaul
data.description:
Strong Petrochemical Holdings Limited ( (HK:0852) ) has shared an announcement.

Strong Petrochemical Holdings Limited has resolved governance and compliance issues that led to a suspension of its shares in December 2024, including disputes involving current and former directors. The group undertook an independent forensic investigation, strengthened internal controls, and addressed regulatory concerns to meet all resumption requirements set by the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

Following publication of its outstanding financial results and demonstration of adequate internal controls and regulatory compliance, the company has fulfilled all resumption guidance. Trading in its shares will resume on 16 September 2026, with the board emphasizing renewed governance, operational stability, and a commitment to creating sustainable long-term value for shareholders.

data.title: Mininglamp Technology Shareholders Clear Tencent Technical Services Pact at EGM

Mininglamp Technology reported that shareholders overwhelmingly approved an ordinary resolution at its extraordinary general meeting on September 15, 2026, to ratify and confirm a Tencent Technical Services Procurement Supplemental Framework Agreement. The vote was carried by poll with virtually unanimous support across both Class A and Class B shares, underscoring strong shareholder backing for continued collaboration with Tencent on technical services.

The resolution authorizes a director to execute all necessary documents and actions related to the supplemental framework agreement, effectively clearing governance and compliance hurdles for the arrangement to proceed. This approval reinforces Mininglamp Technology’s strategic alignment with a major technology partner, potentially strengthening its operational capabilities and market positioning, while signaling stable support from investors despite the company’s weighted voting rights structure.
